items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: he came by and said, “Geez you guys I sure like what you do, geez I sure like what you do.” So it turned out to be Kenny Dorham.

ctx.x: And then of course, then as time went on we’d do ballads and we’d do standards, and when we went to Jenkins he had singers, so we’d back singers, so whatever the singer had we’d back it. And then of course since singing started to become popular so we would try to do some of the Nat King Cole things that he did at the time. [sings] Straighten up and fly right, you know. And we’d do well it was a mixed variety. And so then while we were at Jenkins we looked up in the audience and there was this guy with a trumpet…
